description: Khada wears a long teal crossed-front noble coat with rich gold woven scroll and geometric borders at the collar, cuffs, overlapping front and hem. Light brown fur trims the sleeve cuffs. A pale linen underlayer shows at the neck and lower front. An ornate brown decorated belt carries round bronze fittings, while a narrow gold-patterned sash hangs in fringed ends. Loose dark trousers tuck into dark brown boots with gold embroidered designs. Both hands and feet are visible. The layered fabrics are fully opaque. No headgear, armor or weapon appears.
